column1: # The lib test split's view of CI (scripts/dev/test_parts_expect.py reads it). Tab-separated.
# config <target triple> <cargo feature flags> <custom cfgs the job sets, comma-separated>: one CI build of the lib test
#   code. X9 refuses a test that compiles in none of them. scripts/ci/test_feature_shards.py holds the feature sets
#   equal to what the workflows pass (--all-features and every feature-combos entry, per target).
# nowhere <test path> <reason>: a test written for platforms CI does not have; X9 lets it pass. Shrink-only.

column3: gated not(any(unix, windows)): written for platforms with neither, which CI does not have
